evidence.quote: Our opening proposal is $48 million for the class and $8 million in fees and expenses paid separately
any fee amount not approved by the court added to the class fund
We maintain automatic distribution and no clear-sailing commitment.
Brightline will not oppose the fee request

summary: The plaintiff raised fees in its opening proposal, and the parties negotiated fees alongside class relief before reaching a deal. The fee-reversion term expressly connects any reduction in approved fees to an increase in the class fund. The declaration misleadingly says Brightline will not oppose the fee request, despite the negotiated absence of a clear-sailing commitment.
